**POSCO Future M Co., Ltd.** ([Korean](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Korean_language "Korean language"):주식회사 포스코퓨처엠[cathode](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cathode "Cathode") and [anode](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anode "Anode") materials for [lithium-ion batteries](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lithium-ion_batteries "Lithium-ion batteries"),[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/POSCO_Future_M#cite_note-10) [refractories](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Refractories "Refractories") and basic industrial materials.
They changed the company name from POSCO Chemical to POSCO FUTURE M in March 2023.
## Businesses
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=POSCO_Future_M&action=edit&section=1 "Edit section: Businesses")]
### Battery materials
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=POSCO_Future_M&action=edit&section=2 "Edit section: Battery materials")]
POSCO Future M produces [cathode](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cathode "Cathode") active materials and [anodes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anodes "Anodes") for EV batteries.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/POSCO_Future_M#cite_note-11) It is showing rapid growth by receiving a total of approximately 100 trillion won in cathode material orders from major domestic battery companies ([LG Energy Solution](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LG_Energy_Solution "LG Energy Solution"), [Samsung SDI](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Samsung_SDI "Samsung SDI"), etc.) in 2023. As of 2023, it has a production capacity of 155,000 tons. The company has set a goal of producing 1 million tons of cathode materials by 2030 and is aggressively expanding its plants. They also plan to increase production of precursors and cathode materials from 45,000 tons and 82,000 tons, respectively, in 2023 to 460,000 tons and 370,000 tons in 2030.[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/POSCO_Future_M#cite_note-12)
### Industrial and chemical materials
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=POSCO_Future_M&action=edit&section=3 "Edit section: Industrial and chemical materials")]
POSCO Future M produces and supplies refractories and quicklime, which are basic industrial materials. In addition to this, they also produce advanced chemical materials such as carbon materials and hydrogen peroxide. Recently, they appears that 100% recycling of waste refractories has been successful.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/POSCO_Future_M#cite_note-13)
### ESG
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=POSCO_Future_M&action=edit&section=4 "Edit section: ESG")]
Various policies are being implemented under POSCO Group's ESG management philosophy of 'Corporate Citizens Growing Together'.[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/POSCO_Future_M#cite_note-14) For example, the company publishes 'corporate citizenship report' every year to inform its ESG activities.[[15]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/POSCO_Future_M#cite_note-15) In addition, by publishing a 'responsible minerals report', they are making it known that they are manufacturing products by procuring minerals that do not involve labor exploitation or funds flowing into illegal organizations. Recently, the company was recognized for its ESG performance by being included in the DJSI Asia Pacific Index.[[16]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/POSCO_Future_M#cite_note-16)

### Business description: Posco Future M Co., Ltd.
![Posco Future M Co., Ltd.](https://cdn.zonebourse.com/static/instruments-logo-59126435.png)
Posco Future M Co Ltd, formerly Posco Chemical Co Ltd, is a Korea-based company mainly engaged in the production and sale of cathode and anode materials. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Energy Materials Business segment is engaged in the production and sale of battery materials such as cathode and anode materials. The Basic Materials Business segment includes refractory business that engages in the refractory manufacturing and industrial furnace maintenance as well as lime chemical business that engages in the quicklime, chemical product processing and sales, chemical plant consignment operation. 
Number of employees: 2,515
